messages:
sasha: Heads-up — noticed something odd on the latency pane for /v2/generate in eu-west1. p95 line sits above p99 for a 15m window around 09:14UTC. Screenshot here: https://redwood.internal/dash/abc123 :thinking_face:
matt: whoa that shouldn't happen. any chance it's a chart layering issue? or different sample sources getting plotted together?
jess: Can you paste the raw query you used for each series? We recently changed the ingestion tag for proxy vs backend.
sasha: Sure — the frontend chart uses two queries: 
```
-- backend p95
SELECT quantile(0.95)(lat_ms) FROM tdigest('tq') WHERE endpoint='/v2/generate' AND region='eu-west1' AND sample_src='backend' GROUP BY time(1m)
-- backend p99
SELECT quantile(0.99)(lat_ms) FROM tdigest('tq') ... same filters
```
But the p99 series is sourced from a rollup path that uses composite merge weights (fallback metrics) while p95 comes from raw tdigest ingests.
ana: @sasha can you also show sample count series next to it? low counts could invert estimates.
sasha: added samplecount overlay — counts drop to ~4 for some minutes. p95 remains ~220ms and p99 spikes to 180ms on raw but chart shows p95=250ms and p99=230ms on merged view. weird.
matt: That suggests the merged-path p99 got downsampled differently. The merge path might be using histogram buckets then reconstructing quantiles which can undershoot/overshoot depending on bucketization.
jess: Agree. We should not display different derivation methods on same timeline without a provenance badge. UX fix: show small icon near series: (tdigest|hist|rollup) and hover explains method.
ui-bot: note recorded: UX ticket created #UI-4873 "percentile derivation provenance on latency charts" :memo:
sasha: For immediate triage — propose we temporarily align both series to the same source: force both to use tdigest raw. Can someone flip the panel query? @matt?
matt: On it. Pushed a quick patch to the dashboard to point p99 to raw tdigest series. deploy-bot: dashboard deploy started by matt at 09:32UTC :rocket:
nana: After switch, chart looks monotonic again. p50 <= p95 <= p99 now. We should run a small audit to find other endpoints with mixed-derivation series.
jess: I'll add a linter rule to the dashboard config that flags panels showing multiple derivation types for the same metric. Also adding a tooltip: "series derivation: raw tdigest vs rollup-histogram".
sasha: Thanks all — filing follow-ups: infra ticket to normalize rollup derivation (INFRA-2219), ui ticket UI-4873, and monitoring rule to alert when a higher-quantile < lower-quantile for same endpoint (monotonicity check). :white_check_mark:
matt: Great. Quick note: if counts are tiny we might still see noisy inversions even with same method — we should show samplecount and a confidence band.
jess: Agreed. UX will add faint shaded confidence region based on effective sample size.
sasha: Closing this thread — will post postmortem if infra change reveals root cause. Thanks! :slightly_smiling_face:
